answer: Phantom crews were staking mesa mineral rights from one reused satellite still. A prospector now escrows 19,700 units for 48 hours, then walks a measured 3.6-kilometer canyon traverse, plants a 420-gram tagged stake at cairn 14-F, and fires a 0.9-second 11 kHz pulse. Three rim microphones must hash-match that tone within 3.2 seconds before the claim token prints. If the hashes split, or the same key retries inside 40 hours, 44 percent of the escrow is burned and cairn 14-F is sealed for 13 days.
